config_rows.label: Pro high reasoning, healing=ON, par=2 (observed baseline)

why_candidate: The original 2/17 missing baseline blocks were fully reproduced as successes in the confirmatory high-reasoning probe.
Low reasoning fixed completeness but materially reduced findings and is not recall-safe.
Healing OFF was not the differentiator; the stable signal was high reasoning on the flaky blocks.
why_not_winner_yet: Median probe-informed Pro still trails Claude on findings (32 vs 64).
Even optimistic probe-informed Pro trails Claude on added findings (+25 vs +46).
Low-reasoning Pro variants underperform both median counterfactual Pro and Claude (14 / 13 findings).
recommendation.recommended_next_step: If Pro needs a final admission test, run only one narrow 17-block high-reasoning second-pass rerun with the strict single-block success rule and the current retry guardrails. Do not use low reasoning for recall-oriented second pass.
